title: Age-related risk of acute intracranial injury in craniomaxillofacial trauma: a 16-year cohort study with focus on older adults with isolated facial fractures
authors_text: Zhongzheng Cao, Ruipeng Zhang, Ping Wang, Xinyu Song, Yulu Yang, Yifan Tu, Yixiao Tang, Mengfei Wang, Yunyi Li, Jia Wang, Han Zhang, Xiaoer Wei, Dan Wang, Yuehua Li
abstract: A 16-year cohort study examining age-related risk of acute intracranial injury after craniomaxillofacial trauma, with a focus on older adults with isolated facial fractures.
